items.question: Which divine beings receive the instruction after Sadashiva meditates on the goddess's words?
premises: Sadashiva meditates after hearing the goddess's words.
Sadashivas and lords are named as recipients.
The dative forms indicate direction toward them.
items.inference: The verse identifies Sadashivas and lords as recipients of the teaching.
uncertainties: The verse fragment lacks the main verb.
items.plain_english: Sadashivas and lords, to all of them indeed, and...
